messages:
maya: FYI — planning a staged maintenance Fri 2026-04-02 03:00–05:00 UTC on eu-west fabric (NIC microcode + BMC). We'll do rolling reboots per rack and a controlled egress-capacity swap to reduce thermal risk. Aiming for minimal impact to Dedicated pools.

alex: what's the fallback if cross-region egress bottlenecks?

maya: plan: 1) gradual prefix swap to us-east backup pool, 2) per-rack egress throttle to 100MB/s, 3) route non-critical / large-model traffic to quantized variants, 4) pre-warm KV/prefix caches.

jason: how are we doing the pre-warm for large models? synthetic traffic might blow up token costs.

maya: use the warmup service with small prompts and limited concurrency. script below — 1 req per second per model for 5 mins per rack.

```bash
# example warmup (run from infra-warmers)
for model in gpt-7-small gpt-7-q4; do
  seq 1 300 | xargs -n1 -P2 -I{} curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-internal/warmup -H 'Authorization: Bearer $WARM_KEY' -d '{"model":"'$model'","prompt":"warmup"}' >/dev/null
done
```

samir: need to notify Dedicated customers and ensure no-evict policy for their reserved nodes, right?

maya: yes — we'll publish console banner + email tonight. For Dedicated: set route policy to "no-evict" unless latency > 2x baseline for >10m. product will handle compensation discussions.

priya: abort criteria?

maya: abort if any of: (a) sustained qps drop >10% for 10m, (b) error rate increases >1% absolute for 5m, (c) P99 latency >2x baseline for 5m. Canary: 2 racks for 20m then proceed if stable.

oncall-bot: scheduled maintenance created: infra/maintenance/4325000000 — owners: maya, alex, jason (pageresponder: oncall-sre)

deploy-bot: rolling reboot plan posted. cohorts: rack-eu-1a -> rack-eu-1b -> rack-eu-2a -> rack-eu-2b. each cohort drain target 8 min, cooldown 10 min.

alex: I'll monitor prefix cache fill and bump warmers if we see >50% miss rate during canary.

maya: ops runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/egress-swap (DM me for perms).

jason: I'll pause big evals / gradient runs on eu-west for the window and throttle background syncs to 20% of baseline.

samir: outreach draft ready. adding a sentence about expected short latency blips and contact for SLA questions.

maya: perfect — product will own the SLA followups and comp. ops will tag affected tenants in the maintenance ticket.

alex: :thumbsup:
